100 prisoners are given a chance to be freed. There is a room with 100 boxes, each containing a slip with a prisoner's number (1-100). Each prisoner may enter the room one by one and open up to 50 boxes. They must leave the room exactly as they found it. If every prisoner finds their own number, all are freed. If even one fails, all are executed. They can strategize beforehand but cannot communicate once the game starts. Describe the optimal strategy and calculate its approximate probability of success.
